what_happened: Root-cause and fix design located cleanly within one script (lean-plan-compliance-check.sh) with zero change needed to the calling agent file's step 5 code block, step 0, or steps 1-4 -- the script already receives the plan file path it needs to derive both widening sources (Files-to-modify harvest via an existing core-extension script, and the Challenge manifest). Reused plan-file-scope-harvest.sh rather than designing a new plan parser.

Concurrent sibling task #504 (also 'researching' this cycle) declares file_scope on the exact same two files this task's recommendation touches (lean-plan-compliance-check.sh and its test suite), for an unrelated defect (over-broad Goals-prose backtick harvest, narrowing WHICH names are harvested) vs. this task's concern (WHERE a harvested name is searched). Changes land in different regions of the same files and should not textually conflict, but flagged in the report's Risks section for re-read-before-edit discipline at implement time.

Plan-phase synthetic reproduction confirmed the defect live before any implementation: a Goal declared only in a plan-named specs/evidence probe file yields [MISSING]/failed/exit 1, while plan-file-scope-harvest.sh on the same plan returns exactly that probe path. The whole fix mechanism (harvester output -> widened grep scope) was validated end-to-end at authoring time, and the existing suite baseline was measured clean at 19/19, so Phase 1's criterion is a satisfiable absolute rather than a guessed delta.

Out-of-scope adjacent blind spot recorded as a follow-up candidate: lean-implementation-agent.md's step 6 comparator-gate Preflight 4 resolves comparator_solution_module via its own inline grep over the same roots-only scope, so widening find_decl_files does NOT fix it. A probe-pinned plan that also opts into --compare will still hit comparator_solution_module_unresolved after this task lands. Deliberately not folded in: the dispatch names exactly one additional sub-check to widen (the replacement-target sweep).
